name: CB AI Autoreply for Contact Form 7
author: cb-hideyuki Muto

sections.description:
CB AI Autoreply for Contact Form 7 is a powerful WordPress plugin that bridges Contact Form 7 with OpenAI’s ChatGPT API, enabling your website to provide intelligent, automated responses to form submissions. Transform your static contact forms into dynamic, AI-powered communication tools that enhance user experience and support conversion goals.

Key Features

  • Real-time AI Responses: Automatically generate intelligent responses using ChatGPT API
  • Seamless CF7 Integration: Works directly with your existing Contact Form 7 forms
  • Flexible Display Options: Show AI responses via customizable shortcodes
  • Email Integration: Send AI-generated responses directly to users via email
  • Multiple Form Support: Configure different AI responses for different forms
  • Data Management: View, filter, and export form submission data
  • API Support: Compatible with GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4, and GPT-4-turbo OpenAI models

Premium Features Available

  • Intelligent Prompt Creation: Full customization of AI prompts for personalized responses
  • HTML Response Display: Advanced shortcode formatting with custom HTML design
  • HTML Email Templates: Rich email formatting with multimedia support and advanced styling
  • Email Delay Functionality: Schedule automated responses (5 minutes to 3 days delay options)
  • Advanced Data Management: Enhanced filtering, bulk operations, and comprehensive export options
  • Extended Date Field Tags: Multiple date/time formatting options for dynamic content

How It Works

  1. User submits a Contact Form 7 form
  2. Form data is sent to ChatGPT API with your custom prompt
  3. AI generates an intelligent response based on the submission
  4. Response is displayed on your website and/or sent via email
  5. All interactions are logged for review and analysis

Use Cases

  • Customer Support: Provide instant, intelligent responses to customer inquiries with consistent quality and rapid turnaround
  • Consultation Services: Deliver professional responses to user consultations while naturally incorporating company product appeals
  • Product Information: Handle diverse product inquiries efficiently with comprehensive company product introductions
  • FAQ Automation: Generate personalized answers to frequently asked questions with dynamic, context-aware responses

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 plugin (active)
  • OpenAI API key (requires OpenAI account)
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Third-Party Service Notice

This plugin connects to OpenAI’s ChatGPT API to generate intelligent responses.

Data Transmission:
When a form is submitted through Contact Form 7, the following data is sent to OpenAI’s servers:
– Form field values entered by users
– Custom prompts configured by site administrators
– No personally identifiable information is stored by this plugin beyond the user’s session

OpenAI Data Handling:
– Form data is processed by OpenAI to generate AI responses
– OpenAI may temporarily store data according to their data retention policies
– Users should review OpenAI’s privacy policy for complete data handling details
– API usage is billed according to OpenAI’s pricing structure

Service Dependencies:
– Plugin functionality requires active internet connection
– OpenAI API availability affects response generation
– API key and account required from OpenAI platform

Learn more about OpenAI’s services:
– Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/
– Terms of Service: https://openai.com/terms/
– API Pricing: https://openai.com/pricing/
– Data Usage Policies: https://openai.com/policies/usage-policies
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CB AI Autoreply for Contact Form 7”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin files
  2. Upload the entire cb-aacf7 folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel

Configuration

  1. Get OpenAI API Key: Visit https://platform.openai.com/api-keys to obtain your API key
  2. Configure Global Settings: Go to Contact > cb-aacf7 Settings
  3. Enter API Key: Add your OpenAI API key in the global settings
  4. Set Up Forms: Edit your Contact Form 7 forms and configure ChatGPT settings
  5. Test Integration: Use the built-in connection test to verify your setup

For detailed setup guides, advanced configuration options, and enterprise features, visit our comprehensive documentation.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes, you need an active OpenAI account and API key. Visit https://platform.openai.com/api-keys to sign up and obtain your key. OpenAI charges based on usage according to their pricing structure.

Is Contact Form 7 required?

Yes, this plugin is specifically designed to work with Contact Form 7. You must have Contact Form 7 installed and activated.

Which OpenAI models are supported?

The plugin supports all current OpenAI models including GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4, and GPT-4-turbo. You can select your preferred model in the settings. Premium version includes access to latest models and custom fine-tuning options.

How do I display AI responses on my website?

Use the [ai_response] shortcode anywhere on your site. Premium version offers additional shortcodes with advanced styling and conditional display options.

Can I customize the AI prompts?

Yes, basic prompt customization is available in the free version. The premium version provides advanced prompt templates, conditional logic, industry-specific presets, and A/B testing capabilities for optimal response quality.

How is my data handled?

Form submissions are temporarily sent to OpenAI for processing. The plugin stores session data locally and provides export functionality for data management. Premium version includes advanced data retention controls and GDPR compliance tools. Review OpenAI’s privacy policy for details on their data handling.

What happens if the API is unavailable?

The plugin includes error handling to gracefully manage API failures. Forms will still function normally, but AI responses may not be generated during outages. Premium version includes failover options and backup response systems.

Can I use this with multiple forms?

Yes, you can configure different AI behaviors for each Contact Form 7 form on your website. Premium version offers bulk configuration tools and template sharing across multiple sites.

Is there a limit on form submissions?

The free version has no artificial limits – only OpenAI API usage applies. Premium version includes usage optimization features and cost management tools to help you get the most value from your OpenAI investment.

Do you offer support?

Community support is available through WordPress.org forums. Premium users receive priority email support with faster response times and direct access to our development team.
